answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 104 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ledge. The zephyr index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the dune queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 61 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
